meta.title: 自由泳高肘抱水，看完让你更走水
meta.title_en: Freestyle High-Elbow Catch That Moves You Forward

scenes.context: 自由泳抱水不要抱90度，否则肩关节会疼。正确动作是送肩前伸，往斜下方抱水。
sentences: 抱水不要抱90度，会导致肩关节会疼。
Don't catch the water at 90 degrees—it hurts your shoulder.
正确动作是送肩前伸，往斜下方抱水。
The correct move is to lead with the shoulder and reach forward.
往斜下方抱，肩关节才不会痛。
Catch diagonally downward to spare your shoulder.
scenes.speak: Don't catch the water at 90 degrees—it hurts your shoulder. The correct move is to lead with the shoulder and reach forward. Catch diagonally downward to spare your shoulder.

scenes.context: 抱水时手不要过身体中线，推水时转肩、送肩前伸。手保持在肩宽范围内，才能保持身体平衡与划水效率。
sentences: Don't let your hand cross the centerline.
Rotate the shoulder as you push and lead it forward.
两边肩转换交替起来，这才是正确的自由泳抱水。
Alternate the shoulders side to side—that's the right freestyle catch.
scenes.speak: Don't let your hand cross the centerline. Rotate the shoulder as you push and lead it forward. Alternate the shoulders side to side—that's the right freestyle catch.

practice: Don't catch the water at 90 degrees—it hurts your shoulder.
Lead with the shoulder, reach forward, catch diagonally.
Keep the hand inside the centerline and rotate the shoulder.
Alternate the shoulders side to side in the catch.
pitfalls: Keep the hand inside the shoulder line for balance.
Lead with the shoulder and catch diagonally instead.
Rotate the shoulder as you push and lead it forward.
shifts: 用 catch the water（抱水）、lead with the shoulder（送肩）、centerline（中线）
用 rotate（转动）、alternate（交替）、diagonally（斜向地）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播（繁体字幕）。已校正：抱水不要抱90度会导致肩关节疼、正确动作是送肩前伸往斜下方抱水、抱水时不要过身体中线、推水时转肩送肩前伸、两边肩转换交替才是正确的自由泳抱水等。
